about: Trick-or-treat hours for every La Porte County, IN community, read by laporteweathernow.com/trick-or-treat (the page updates within about 10 minutes of a change here; no site publish needed). Rules: put hours under 'hours' only when the town itself (its website, council, police or official social page) or reliable local news has announced them for this year, with that source and status 'official' (the town or its police) or 'reported' (local news). Until then hours stays null and 'last' shows last year's hours with their source. Never copy last year's hours into 'hours'. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD and times are 24-hour Central Time. 'events' are extra trick-or-treat events with their own date, hours and source; drop or correct one if its organizer changes it.

towns.name: La Porte

hours.note: Turn your porch light on if you're handing out treats.

towns.announces: The city's Board of Public Works and Safety sets the hours; they're posted on the city events calendar (livinthelakelife.org/events) and the city's Facebook page.
